rules.statement: An instrument in writing by which the incumbent of a Temple appoints his successor is a will provided it is drawn up in proper form, and such an instrument is one by which property is affected within the meaning of section 518 of the Civil Procedure Code.
rules.supporting_quote: "An instrument in writing by which the incumbent of a Temple appoints his successor is a will provided it is drawn up in proper form. Such an instrument is one by which property is affected within the meaning of section 518 of the Civil Procedure Code."
